en.title: Ewan McGregor Begs Disney for More Obi-Wan: 'Come On!'
en.summary: The beloved Jedi Master is ready for his return, and Ewan McGregor is making sure Disney knows it. The actor is actively campaigning for more Star Wars adventures as Obi-Wan Kenobi, putting the pressure on Lucasfilm to greenlight new projects.
en.body:
Ewan McGregor is not shy about his desire to don the Jedi robes once more. While promoting his latest film, "The End of Oak Street," the actor made it clear that the ball is firmly in Disney's court when it comes to reprising his iconic role as Obi-Wan Kenobi. McGregor has been vocal about his eagerness to continue exploring the legendary Jedi's journey, particularly the period between "Revenge of the Sith" and "A New Hope."

> "Somebody give me a job. Come on Disney. We know I want to do it. Just let me do it, because it’s fun to do."

McGregor's plea comes after the successful, albeit limited, run of the **Obi-Wan Kenobi** Disney+ series in 2022. The show, which began shooting in April 2021, picked up ten years after Kenobi faced his greatest defeat: the fall of Anakin Skywalker and the rise of Darth Vader. The series was billed as a "special event series," but the appetite for more stories featuring the weathered Jedi Master clearly remains strong, at least for McGregor himself.

## The Jedi's Plea to the Mouse House

The actor's latest comments amplify his ongoing campaign to convince Lucasfilm and Disney to greenlight more Obi-Wan adventures. He's not just hoping for a call; he's actively putting pressure on the studio. McGregor has previously pointed out the narrative gap between his portrayal in the prequel trilogy, where he hands Luke Skywalker to his aunt and uncle, and his eventual appearance as the hermit-like Alec Guinness in **A New Hope**. This period, filled with the trauma of Order 66 and the rise of the Empire, offers fertile ground for storytelling that fans have clearly embraced.

> "The next time we find Obi-Wan Kenobi, he’s Alec Guinness up in the mountains. What happens between those two moments?"

This persistent push from McGregor suggests a genuine passion for the character and a belief that there are still compelling stories to tell. For fans who grew up with McGregor's Obi-Wan and were captivated by his performance in the Disney+ series, the possibility of more is an exciting prospect. The success of the original series, despite some critical reservations, demonstrated a significant audience demand for this era of Star Wars storytelling.

## What's Next for Obi-Wan?

While McGregor is making his case loud and clear, official confirmation of any new Obi-Wan Kenobi projects remains elusive. Details about potential future installments or a second season of the series have not yet been announced by Disney or Lucasfilm. However, McGregor's continued advocacy ensures that the conversation around Obi-Wan's future in the galaxy far, far away is very much alive, keeping fans hopeful for new adventures.
